# Lifescience Global

> Academic publishing platform specializing in peer-reviewed journals focused on child health, nutrition, and pediatric research.

Lifescience Global Canada Inc. is an academic publisher that disseminates research through open-access journals, with particular emphasis on child health and nutrition topics. The platform indexes content across major academic databases and maintains rigorous peer-review standards.

## Key Topics

- child health
- nutrition
- pediatric research
- academic journals
- peer-reviewed articles
- childhood obesity
- malnutrition
- breastfeeding
- public health
- metabolic syndrome
- food insecurity
- special issues
- conference proceedings
- editorial boards
- academic publishing

- [Homepage](https://lifescienceglobal.com): Lifescience Global Canada Inc. homepage for academic publishing
- [Journals Directory](https://lifescienceglobal.com/journals): Directory of academic journals including child health and nutrition

## International Journal of Child Health and Nutrition

- [Journal Main Page](https://lifescienceglobal.com/journals/international-journal-of-child-health-and-nutrition): International Journal of Child Health and Nutrition main page
- [Editor's Choice Articles](https://lifescienceglobal.com/journals/international-journal-of-child-health-and-nutrition/editor-s-choice-international-journal-of-child-health-and-nutrition): Editor's choice articles on child health and nutrition topics
- [Special Issues](https://lifescienceglobal.com/journals/international-journal-of-child-health-and-nutrition/special-issues-international-journal-of-child-health-and-nutrition): Special issues on childhood obesity and maternal wellbeing
- [Guidelines for Conference Proceedings](https://lifescienceglobal.com/journals/international-journal-of-child-health-and-nutrition/guidelines-for-conference-proceedings): Submission guidelines for conference proceedings and special issues
